dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product turns settings on and off with an immediate effect, on and off, enabled and disabled, some with a glyph in the handle that says which.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a switch reads: the track, its outline and shape, the round state layer (container) that follows the handle, the size and the weight of the glyph in the handle, the handle size while it shows one, the label style and gap, and for each condition (unselected, selected) the container / track / outline / handle / icon / label colors, the handle size and the handle elevation in each state.
rules: A switch applies its change at once. A choice that is confirmed later (a form with a submit button) is a checkbox.
The handle sits at the inline start when off and at the inline end when on; right-to-left mirrors it.
Hover, focus and press show on the container (the round layer around the handle), never on the track.
The handle may change size by condition and state (in the default system 16 off, 24 on, 28 under a press); its center never leaves the track's midline, half the track height from the end.

The glyph in the handle is a glyph of the system's icon set, named by selectedIcon / unselectedIcon, drawn at icon.size and at icon.weight. Never draw a path or character of your own; a system that wants another mark chooses another icon set.

icon.weight is the handle glyph's own weight, not sys.icon.weight: the glyph is the smallest the system draws, on a handle 24 across, so the default draws it heavier than its icons (sys.icon.mark.weight). To make it easier or harder to see, change icon.weight; never change icon.size or the handle for that.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.
Each condition's state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into its container; it aliases that condition's outline color.

size.$description: The round state layer centered on the handle, Material Design 3's 40; it moves with the handle and reaches 4 beyond the track's ends.

width.$description: The length of the track, Material Design 3's 52.

height.$description: The height of the track, Material Design 3's 32. The handle's center is half of it from the track's end.

width.$description: The border of the track, drawn inside its edge; the fill sits inside the border and never under it. Material Design 3's 2.

size-with-icon.$description: The smallest diameter of the handle while it shows an icon, Material Design 3's 24; a larger size of the condition and state wins.

size.$description: The glyph box inside the handle: the icon set's glyph (check, close…) at a step of the icon scale, Material Design 3's 16.

weight.$description: The weight the glyph in the handle is drawn at (the `wght` axis of the icon font), in both conditions: the system's weight for a control's own mark, heavier than its icons in the default system. The glyph box (icon.size) does not change with it; only the stroke does.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product draws its icons light and marks its switches with a check and a close mark: at the smallest step of the icon scale, on a handle 24 across, a light stroke is under a pixel wide and the off glyph has little contrast with its handle to begin with. A product that finds the two glyphs too faint, or too heavy for a quiet settings page, sets their weight without touching its icons or its checkboxes.

gap.$description: From the track to the label.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

size.$description: The diameter of the handle while off, Material Design 3's 16. Its center stays on one line whatever the size: half the track height from the track's end.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The state layer is invisible at rest; hover, focus and press mix into it.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

selection-duration.$description: How long the handle takes to travel along the track, and the track and handle to change color, when the switch changes.
